faq.a: Dilution guidance is provided per product. Common guides: 1% for sensitive adults, 2–3% for short-term topical use; consult a qualified provider for special conditions.

faq.q: How do I do a patch test?
faq.a: Apply a small diluted drop to the inner forearm and wait 24 hours. If irritation occurs, discontinue use.

faq.q: Are essential oils safe for pets?
faq.a: Some oils can affect animals. Use diffusers in well-ventilated areas, limit exposure, and consult a veterinarian for concerns.

faq.q: Can I use blends during pregnancy?
faq.a: Please consult your care provider before using new essential oils during pregnancy.
